intro: Secure your world with the Verge Digital Safe, offering personalized protection and peace of mind with advanced digital locking, emergency access, and a built-in alarm for ultimate safety.

features.title: Digital locking mechanism
features.text: Unlock with ease and security. The 4-8 digit password ensures only you have access, with a master password for emergency entry, keeping your valuables safe and secure.

features.title: Autolock keypad freeze function
features.text: Your security, your peace of mind. After 5 wrong attempts, the keypad automatically locks, ensuring unauthorized access is prevented, keeping your valuables protected.

features.title: Robust cable lock
features.text: Add an extra layer of protection. The robust cable lock allows you to securely anchor your locker, preventing removal or tampering for superior security.

features.title: External USB charging support
features.text: Never worry about battery power again. The external USB charging port lets you easily recharge your locker, ensuring that your security is always powered up and ready.

features.title: Emergency mechanical override
features.text: Never worry about access. In case of low battery or forgotten password, the mechanical override key provides an instant solution to keep your valuables within reach.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
name: Verge Pl 2 Litres Steel Digital Home Locker
